title: Advancing freely with an open beginning

captions.physics: Bringing a useful first result closer
captions.emotions: Joy in an open new experience

meaning: Freely chosen participation can inspire you when advancing an endeavour together preserves the pleasure of an open new experience.
text: A new shared path can be free while remaining definite in action. The Devil in the energy of Sahasrara supports awareness of attachment, noticing reward, recognition or a ready image of your role and reclaiming choice. The Chariot in the physical position describes shared actions: finding direction, moving through obstacles and bringing an accessible useful result closer. The Fool in emotions brings the fresh pleasure of beginning. It feels rewarding that new participation need not confirm an earlier outward image. Shared meaning can start through an actual opportunity for others while leaving the future living room to develop differently.

For example, you help a small open workshop reach its first evening together. Noticing a wish to appear founders of a large project immediately, you return to chosen usefulness and find a manageable path to an actual beginning. **Free shared movement leaves new meaning an open continuation.** A first visitor tries a material unexpectedly, bringing fresh interest. Your work helps people meet and begin attempts of their own, with further development through questions and initiatives you could not invent for everybody beforehand.

Progress becomes harder if the first successful result is quickly fixed as compulsory for the future. New people have another manageable approach, but the endeavour requires repetition. Conscious motivation and the pleasure of openness remain supportive. Action benefits from distinguishing direction from a final image, retaining foundations while allowing a beginning to remain a beginning rather than a permanent limit to development.
